architectureDecisions: D1 — In createOracleContextResolver.preObserve, wrap sourceCatalog.authorityFor in try/catch. On TypeError whose message includes missing/ambiguous snapshot authority, record a typed skip for that evidence (do not observe, do not throw). Other TypeErrors rethrow.

D2 — resolve() after preObserve: for each evidence with a typed skip, push unresolved {evidenceId, reason:'CURRENTNESS_UNVERIFIABLE'} and do not include that evidence in execute() candidate success. Skip retrieve by passing remainingBudget that still allows other evidence, or filter requirement.evidence for execute to evidence without the skip. Zero retrieve calls for the skipped evidence. Status uses existing statusFor (REQUIRED => UNSATISFIED).

D3 — Overflow loop: when the catch is consumed below materialization/step and dropOrder is exhausted, push BUDGET_EXHAUSTED for remaining overflowing evidence and build with items=[] (or the last passing subset) instead of rethrowing. If even the empty item list cannot satisfy consumed.materializedBytes >= materialization.bytes under the tiny budget, still return UNSATISFIED with BUDGET_EXHAUSTED rather than throw. Do not change defineContextResolution.

D4 — FA5 in test/oracle-facade-accounting.test.mjs: CONTEXT_GRAPH or REPOSITORY required evidence, catalog with a matching provider but no snapshot authority, resolve() returns UNSATISFIED CURRENTNESS_UNVERIFIABLE and does not throw. FA6: maxMaterializedBytes 1 EXACT file requirement, resolve() returns UNSATISFIED BUDGET_EXHAUSTED and does not throw. Both fail on current main.

D5 — Rewrite test/oracle-context-graph-boundary.test.mjs CG3 without-authority case: facade resolve returns UNSATISFIED CURRENTNESS_UNVERIFIABLE, traverseCalls.length===0, planner execute still CURRENTNESS_UNVERIFIABLE. Keep the STALE and no-snapshot-from-authority cases.
D6 — Existing FA2 ProviderFailure and FA4 STALE_DURING_RESOLUTION tests stay green. Do not catch DurabilityFailure.

D7 — Living docs: docs/living/system/oracle/context-graph.md and state.md describe typed CURRENTNESS_UNVERIFIABLE for a missing authority and typed BUDGET_EXHAUSTED for underflow budgets. No Blackboard ids.
D8 — Evidence: facade-throw-probe-result.json (TypeError missing authority; TypeError consumed below materialization/step; planner CURRENTNESS_UNVERIFIABLE).
implementationSlices: S1 — Missing authority [FA5]: implement D1-D2; FA5 and rewritten CG3 fail on current main then pass.
S2 — Underflow budget [FA6]: implement D3; FA6 fails on current main then passes; FA2/FA4 stay green.
